corrections.description: Prevent the mounted campaign assistant panel from issuing another default-thread POST while the same campaign/profile request is already in flight.
Give assistant thread creation enough time to complete instead of exposing the generic 15-second client abort as a permanent startup failure.
Allow synchronous copy generation to outlive the generic request timeout while preserving the returned server snapshot in the query cache.
Keep generated image buffers out of Inngest step output and reload the stored base only when exact-layer composition needs it.
Derive the active Create Post work from the current URL so client navigation between resumable works hydrates the requested aggregate.
Allow campaigns and materialized templates without a base image to persist their briefing and generate through the canonical from-scratch path.
Keep every creative-work image buffer outside Inngest step results and expire disappeared jobs into a retryable terminal failure.
Preserve nested tool argument types for MiniMax and protect the first Assistant send from Strict Mode cleanup.
Hydrate resumable creative work before rendering and keep ready work without outputs on the executable identity step.
Require explicit human approval of every completed pilot before the canonical campaign flow can enqueue the production batch.

decision.rationale: The frozen production baseline and 11 pre-fix human attempts expose the baseline breakpoints, but none completed, so superiority cannot be claimed. One post-fix human journey completed end to end; keep expansion frozen and address the remaining provider/runtime and UX issues before collecting a full comparative sample.
